name: Skirmish at Echo Ridge
summary: At Echo Ridge, Marshal McBride sends you into a mine overrun by kobolds. Left alone, the garrison fears, they will tighten their hold.

sections.title: Purging the Mine
sections.body: Kobolds dig deep in Echo Ridge Mine, hoarding what they steal and growing in number. Thin their ranks now, before they spread through Northshire Valley, its farms, and its spiritual retreat.

sections.title: A Thin Defense
sections.body: McBride has few soldiers to spare. The garrison guards the southern borders, while unrest is rumored across Elwynn. Prove reliable at Echo Ridge, and you earn the army’s respect and readiness for harder work elsewhere in the kingdom.

faq.q: Why are kobolds infesting the Echo Ridge Mine?
faq.answer: Kobolds are drawn to mineral-rich tunnels and abandoned quarries. With Stormwind’s forces stretched thin, they enter unguarded places like Echo Ridge to dig burrows, hoard gold, and claim shelter underground.
Marshal McBride orders the skirmish. He commands Stormwind Army forces at Northshire Abbey and oversees the valley’s defense with limited manpower.

faq.q: What is the strategic importance of Echo Ridge Mine?
faq.answer: Echo Ridge Mine holds stone and ore needed to maintain Northshire and help rebuild Stormwind. Kobolds on Northshire’s northern border threaten the abbey and nearby vineyards.

faq.q: Where does this mission lead next?
faq.answer: After the first kobold laborers are cleared from the mine, Marshal McBride sends you toward Goldshire to aid the region’s defense.

faq.q: Why doesn't the Stormwind Army clear the mine themselves?
faq.answer: Stormwind’s forces are short on soldiers as they defend distant borders and answer bandit attacks across Elwynn. McBride relies on new recruits for local threats while seasoned guards hold the defensive lines.

faq.q: Are kobolds intelligent enough to be an organized military threat?
faq.answer: Kobold laborers are cowardly and simple-minded alone, but territorial and aggressive in numbers. Left unchecked, they dig winding tunnels, set cavern traps, and draw larger, better-armed vermin.

angles.text: As a human, clearing Echo Ridge is your first true test of arms in defense of your ancestral kingdom. You prove your mettle to Stormwind’s officers.
As an Alliance member, you help reclaim mines holding stone and ore for rebuilding and fortifying human settlements after the war.
As a warrior, you face swarming kobold workers at close quarters among the first entrenched foes you meet.
As a miner, you help make it possible to dig and smelt valuable mineral veins safely across Northshire Valley.
